attributes.postingGuidelines:
The official website of the Corporation for National and Community Service (CNCS) is NationalService.gov. CNCS is using this website to share information in a different format. Using this third party site does not constitute an endorsement by CNCS or any of its employees of the sponsors of the site or the information or products presented on the site. Also, be aware that the privacy protection provided on the NationalService.gov domain may not be available on this site.
You are encouraged to share your comments, ideas, and concerns. CNCS will delete comments that contain abusive, vulgar, offensive, threatening or harassing language, personal attacks of any kind, or offensive terms that target specific individuals or groups. CNCS will delete comments that are clearly off-topic, that promote services or products, or that promote or oppose any political party, person campaigning for elected office, or any ballot proposition. Gratuitous links to sites are viewed as spam and may result in the comment being removed.

attributes.postingGuidelines:
Instructions for Typing or Uploading Comments
•If typing comments into "Comment" field (for short comments), do not upload a file containing duplicate comments.
•Uploaded comments must include the name of the submitter and any organization the submitter represents at the top of the document, even if the submitter is providing that information on the comment form.
•If uploading comments, do not type any information into the "Comment" field. When a file is uploaded, the system will populate that field with the phrase "See attached file(s)."

Instructions for the First and Last Name, and Organization Name Fields
•Individual Commenters. Provide the first and last name of the person commenting in the "First Name" and "Last Name" fields. Leave the box labeled "I am submitting on behalf of a third party" unchecked. If submitting comments on behalf of multiple individuals, use the first and last name of the first individual listed on the comments, but after the last name add "et al." (e.g., "Jane" as first name and "Doe et al." as last name).
•Organizations. Provide the first and last name of an authorized representative of the organization who is responsible for the comments in the "First Name" and "Last Name" fields. Check the box labeled "I am submitting on behalf of a third party" and provide the name of the organization in the "Organization Name" field.

attributes.postingGuidelines:
1.  Submitted comments will be reviewed by the agency before being posted into a docket.  
2.  The final step in submitting a comment provides you with a Tracking Number which indicates your comment was received.   Keep this number for your records -- e-mail the information, capture the information with a screenshot or print a copy.  If you check the docket after it has closed and do not see your submission, contact us.  If you have a Tracking Number we will accept your comment.  
3. Please use leading capitals when entering your information:  
Jane E. Doe
1234 Abc Street  
City, State  Zip-Code

4. If you have trouble submitting a comment, you may contact us (refer to the FR Notice) for assistance.  We will not accept comments via telephone, a comment must be in writing.

attributes.postingGuidelines:
You may send comments, identified by docket number and/or RIN number, by any of the following methods: 
 
• Federal eRulemaking Portal: http://www.regulations.gov. Follow the instructions for sending comments. 
• E-mail:  reportingrule@csb.gov. Include Docket ID- and/or RIN number - in the subject line of the message. 
• Mail:  Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board, 1750 Pennsylvania Ave., NW, Suite 910, Washington, DC  20006  ATTN: Reporting Rule Comment.
 
Posting Restrictions:
 
The CSB will not post comments that contain trade secret or other confidential information, or that are obscene, libelous, threatening, unrelated to the subject as to which comments were solicited, or otherwise evidently inappropriate for posting.

attributes.postingGuidelines:
Please observe these guidelines as you post your comment.  SSA, at its sole discretion, may remove any posting or portion of a posting that does not conform to these guidelines.

Employees
If you are a SSA or DDS employee, you may post comments only in your capacity as a private citizen, i.e., without using official Government time, your official title or contact information, or government resources, including office equipment and information technology such as computers and the Internet.  The only exception is when you are posting the official comments of a DDS.  Comments by SSA employees violate the Standards of Ethical Conduct.

No Account Information, Please!
You should be careful to include in your comments only the information that you wish to make publicly available on the Internet.  We strongly urge you not to include any personal information, such as Social Security numbers or medical information, in your comments.

Stay On Topic
Keep topics focused on the particular proposed rule under consideration.  

Keep It Civil
Please do not use vulgar or profane language or language intended to defame.  SSA may remove or exclude offensive language to ensure a civil and professional atmosphere for all participants.
